text: In Los Angeles, the bank loan officer Christine Brown, hoping for a promotion, [refuses an elderly Romani woman a third extension on her mortgage|wrong|exploitation for profit] and watches Sylvia Ganush led out, begging to keep her house. In the parking garage Sylvia attacks her, tears a button from her coat and [lays a curse on it|origin|curses laid by others]. A fortune teller explains that the Lamia, an ancient demon, will torment her [for three days|rules|death on a deadline] before [dragging her down to Hell|ending|taken to the other side].
